messages:
Miguel (PM): Quick kickoff for an "Onboarding Bundle" initiative — Q2 OKR candidate. Goal: reduce time-to-first-success for new eng teams from days to <2 hours. Draft scope: 1) tiny SDK quickstarts (py + ts) with CI smoke, 2) minimal deployable reference app (chat widget + backend), 3) migration playbook (Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private) + preflight checklist. Thoughts?

Cara (DevEx): Love it. Must-haves: copy-paste run instructions, pinned deps, a smoke CI job that runs on PR, and explicit cost notes (tokens/estimated $). Quickstarts should demo streaming + function-calling. Keep examples <100 LOC each. :rocket:

Anya (Content): Suggest 2 micro-screencasts (auth setup + widget flow). 2-3min each. I can write scripts and do recordings if we lock content. That tends to cut support tickets in half.

Ben (Eng-API): API team asks: include canonical request/response examples, error/retry patterns, and a note on model fallback routing. Also include a tiny token-assert harness so teams can sanity-check billing. Keep the harness single-file.

Elena (Support): Based on recent tickets, include: streaming reconnect example, simple batching cost calc, and an on-prem preflight checklist. If migration playbook lacks validation steps for network/KMS, we'll get noise.

Tom (Eng-Runtime): Heads-up: Private images need to be slim. I'll provide a multi-stage Dockerfile and a prebuilt image tag to speed demos. Also recommend including a quantized model example (4-bit) for cost-sensitive demos. Note: private KMS integration varies by customer; include a placeholder section.

Cara (DevEx): Proposed quickstart matrix: "hello-sync" (simple text gen), "chat-stream" (streaming + reconnect), "embed-finder" (embeddings + vector lookup). Each should have: one-liner, run command, smoke test.

Miguel (PM): Proposed launch criteria: - each quickstart has README + runnable CI smoke - reference app deployable to a demo env with a single command - migration playbook contains preflight checklist + rollback steps - docs & screencasts pass UX content review. Approve?

Ben (Eng-API): Approve. Small add: include a sample routing policy showing fallback to a cheaper compatible model under high load.

Anya (Content): Approve. I'll own scripts and recordings. Timeline: storyboard by Wed, record Thurs.

Cara (DevEx): I'll own code + CI. Plan GH Actions minimal job: checkout, install, run smoke. Example smoke:
```bash
# smoke test for chat-stream
python quickstarts/chat_stream/smoke_test.py --api-key $REDWOOD_KEY --model redwood-1
```

Tom (Eng-Runtime): Dockerfile draft + build instructions by Thu. Will include CPU vs GPU tags and notes about base image size. I'll also publish a small 4-bit model snapshot link for demo.

Elena (Support): I'll draft the on-prem checklist and common troubleshooting snippets (logs to look for, reconnect patterns) by Friday. Will include redacted customer configs.

Miguel (PM): Owners: Cara (quickstarts + CI), Anya (screencasts + docs scripts), Tom (containers & runtime notes), Elena (support checklist), Ben (API samples). I'll open the initiative PR and add OKR: "Starter bundle adoption: 20 trial teams". Please add a one-line owner plan + ETA to the PR by Friday.

devex-bot: Initiative created: https://go/repo/initiatives/23456 — add your one-liner and ETA.

Cara (DevEx): Adding now. ETA: hello-sync + chat-stream PRs by Wed, embed-finder by Fri.

Anya (Content): Storyboards posted in the PR. Recording Thurs morning.

Ben (Eng-API): Posting routing config snippet + token-harness by Thu EOD.

Tom (Eng-Runtime): Dockerfile + multi-stage build posted by Thu.

Elena (Support): Checklist draft up by Friday EOD; will include monitoring/alert thresholds.

Miguel (PM): Thanks all — update the initiative PR and ping me when your one-liners are in. We’ll triage effort in the roadmap sync next Monday. :pray:
